newsitem.title: MEXICO: Alfa proposes 0.74 peso per-share dividend.
newsitem.headline: Alfa proposes 0.74 peso per-share dividend.

text.p: The board at Mexican industrial conglomerate Alfa will propose a dividend payment of 0.74 pesos per outstanding share to its shareholders, the company said in paid newspaper announcements on Tuesday.

Alfa said dividends would be disbursed as a one-time payment on each of the 600 million A class preferential shares outstanding as of March 12 this year. Payments would be made from net fiscal earnings in 1996.
The Alfa board will also propose "raising the level of reserves to acquire its own shares."
Alfa called for an ordinary general shareholders' meeting to be held on March 6, in the Monterrey suburb of San Nicolas de los Garza.
